legend: Blanca has a sequence of n%%ZSMJ0%% integers a1,…,an%%ZSMJ1%% and a positive integer k%%ZSMJ2%%. She can perform operations of the following two types:

Blanca wants to make all n%%ZSMJ12%% numbers equal by applying these operations zero or more times. Help her determine the minimum number of times she needs to perform operations of the first type. (She can perform as many operations of the second type as she wants).
